description: Lists of a table with a declared key are ordered by it

output.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM `sale` AS `sale_view` WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `sale` AS `s0` JOIN `customer` AS `t0` ON `t0`.`customer_no` = `s0`.`customer_no` JOIN `customer` AS `f0` ON `f0`.`customer_no` = `t0`.`customer_no` WHERE (`s0`.`id` = `sale_view`.`id`) AND ((`f0`.`owner` = ? OR `f0`.`visibility` IN ('public', 'authenticated'))) AND (`f0`.`name` = ?))) AND ((`sale_view`.`owner` = ? OR `sale_view`.`visibility` IN ('public', 'authenticated')))

SELECT
  `sale_view`.`id` AS `_key`,
  (CASE WHEN `sale_view`.`id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`sale_view`.`id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`sale_view`.`id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`sale_view`.`id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`sale_view`.`id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`sale_view`.`id`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `id`,
  `sale_view`.`updated_at` AS `updated_at`,
  (CASE WHEN `sale_view`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`sale_view`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`sale_view`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`sale_view`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`sale_view`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`sale_view`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `owner`,
  `sale_view`.`visibility` AS `visibility`,
  `sale_view`.`note` AS `note`,
  `sale_view`.`customer_no` AS `customer_no`,
  (SELECT json_object('id', `r`.`customer_no`, 'owner', (CASE WHEN `r`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END), 'visibility', `r`.`visibility`) FROM `customer` AS `r` WHERE `r`.`customer_no` = `sale_view`.`customer_no` LIMIT 1) AS `customer`,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_group_array(json_object('id', `r`.`sku`, 'owner', (CASE WHEN `r`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END), 'visibility', `r`.`visibility`)), json('[]')) FROM `product` AS `r` JOIN `product_sale` AS `j` ON `j`.`product_id` = `r`.`sku` WHERE `j`.`sale_id` = `sale_view`.`id` ORDER BY `r`.`sku`) AS `products`
FROM `sale` AS `sale_view` WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `sale` AS `s0` JOIN `customer` AS `t0` ON `t0`.`customer_no` = `s0`.`customer_no` JOIN `customer` AS `f0` ON `f0`.`customer_no` = `t0`.`customer_no` WHERE (`s0`.`id` = `sale_view`.`id`) AND ((`f0`.`owner` = ? OR `f0`.`visibility` IN ('public', 'authenticated'))) AND (`f0`.`name` = ?))) AND ((`sale_view`.`owner` = ? OR `sale_view`.`visibility` IN ('public', 'authenticated'))) ORDER BY `sale_view`.`id` ASC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
